# Clyde Abenojar - AI-assisted Web Builder & Full Stack Developer

> Clyde Abenojar builds web apps, AI automation tools, and production business websites. Scoped carefully, built fast, and shipped as working software people actually use.

## Core Capabilities
- **Web Apps & SaaS:** Full-stack development with Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions).
- **AI Automation & Pipelines:** n8n workflow orchestration, LLM inference pipelines, automated lead intake, human-in-the-loop Slack QA, and prompt engineering.
- **Booking & Business Websites:** High-converting landing pages, customer portals, custom forms, and appointment systems for local businesses and trades.
- **3D Modeling & Visualization:** Architectural visualization, interactive WebGL 3D viewports, and custom 3D web experiences.

- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, OGL / WebGL.
- Backend & Database: Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, REST APIs.
- AI & Automation: n8n, OpenAI, Claude, Midjourney, WebGPU / BiRefNet on-device vision models.
